queue.none: No flagged results: nothing waits for the doctor.

hub.intro: The whole family on one page: eight people across four generations, from 18 months to 78 years, records from six places, Noa’s alerts for each of them, and a heart forecast for every adult. Tap anyone in the family tree to change their data.
hub.turn: edit the family, then act on Noa’s alerts
hub.tip1: Tap Khalid and turn off “Smokes or vapes”, or raise his blood pressure: watch his heart risk and 5-year forecast change
hub.tip2: Push anyone into high risk: Noa Forecast adds it to their open alert (never two nudges), or raises a doctor-review alert once that is done, and withdraws it if you bring the risk down
hub.tip3: Set someone under 30, over 74, or “Had a heart attack or stroke”: Noa refuses to score them, and says why
hub.tip4: Book Hind’s overdue visit: Noa found the barrier (shift hours), so it offers a Saturday, not a 4th reminder. Add Maitha, Khalid and Amna to the same trip
hub.tip5: Try “Not now” on anyone: Noa respects it

fc.headline: 10-year heart and stroke risk · {{cat}}
fc.detail: Heart age {{ha}} (real age {{age}}) · Framingham 2008, {{variant}} · a standard 10-year heart-risk formula (needs UAE calibration)
fc.withoutLab: without cholesterol (uses BMI until it is measured)
fc.signalNote: A signal to act on, not a diagnosis. A doctor decides what it means.
fc.caveat: Framingham was developed in a US population and needs local calibration before clinical use in the UAE. The 5-year lines are a what-if using {{n}}’s own trends, not a validated forecast. Family history is not in the score, so Noa Insight shows it separately.
